description: This file contains a class 'JinaAIRerankConfig' implementing transformation logic for reranking from Cohere's format to Jina AI's format, including URL handling, request/response transformation, environment validation, and cost calculation.

classes.name: JinaAIRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for transforming rerank requests/responses between Cohere and Jina AI formats, including URL management, environment validation, and cost estimation.

methods.name: get_supported_cohere_rerank_params
methods.description: Returns list of supported rerank parameters for a given model.

methods.name: map_cohere_rerank_params
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to supported rerank parameters for request formation.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for reranking, defaulting to Jina AI's endpoint if none provided.

methods.name: transform_rerank_request
methods.description: Prepares the request payload with model and parameters.

methods.name: transform_rerank_response
methods.description: Transforms Jina AI's rerank response format to the expected internal format, including error handling and result formatting.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates environment variables and headers, especially API key presence.

methods.name: calculate_rerank_cost
methods.description: Calculates cost based on token usage, with a specified per-token price for Jina AI reranker.
